sections.name: WatchRunLink
sections.title: Link to the recorded replay
sections.what: Shows a link that opens the recorded run with its replay turned on. The link text and tooltip name the recording date and say that nothing new runs.
sections.why: Likely reason: a replay could be mistaken for a live run, so the wording makes clear it is a recording.
sections.watch_out: Scan links carry the run identifier while lessons links do not, so the two paths behave differently and changing one needs checking the other.

summary: A small link, shown only in dark mode, that opens the pinned recorded Reality Scan or Lessons Learnt run as a replay.
purpose: Gives a visitor a one-click way to watch a sample run without starting a new one.
why: The doc comment says the link replays a recorded run and that nothing new runs.
how: 1. Checks whether dark mode is on. 2. Requests the pinned demo runs only when the tool is scan or lessons. 3. Picks the matching pinned run. 4. Builds the link address and a readable date. 5. Renders the link text using the first word of the demo label.
inputs: tool name (scan or lessons) and an optional class name. The pinned demo list comes from the collation demo request.
outputs: A link to the Reality Scan or Lessons Learnt page with replay settings turned on, or nothing at all.
risks: Shows nothing when the demo data is missing or when light mode is on. This fails quietly rather than with an error.
debug: If the link is missing, check dark mode, the demo data request and whether the tool name is exactly scan or lessons. Note that the lessons link does not include a run identifier while the scan link does.
